enabled.label: Enable Trakt sync
enabled.description: Turns Trakt scrobbling and sync on or off. Optional; default off.

username.label: Trakt username
username.description: The Trakt account Phlix is linked to; set automatically during authorization. The plugin stays idle until it is present.

access_token.label: Access token
access_token.description: Obtained automatically when you authorize Phlix with Trakt — you do not enter this by hand. Self-host API credentials (client id/secret/redirect URI) are set host-side on the Phlix server (TRAKT_* environment variables or admin Settings), not in this field; see the README.

refresh_token.label: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Set automatically during authorization; used to renew the access token. Not entered by hand.

expires_at.label: Token expiry
expires_at.description: Unix timestamp when the access token expires. Managed automatically.

sync_enabled.label: Enable history sync
sync_enabled.description: Pulls Trakt watch history into Phlix and lets finished Phlix items be pushed to Trakt. Pulled completions are sized from the Trakt entry runtime when present, else from the local media item duration. Pushing completions additionally requires scrobbling to be enabled. Optional; default on.

sync_interval_minutes.label: Sync interval (minutes)
sync_interval_minutes.description: How often this plugin's own scheduled Trakt→Phlix history pull runs (minutes). The host server may also run its own watch-history sweep on a separate cadence. Optional; default 30.

scrobble_enabled.label: Enable scrobbling
scrobble_enabled.description: Report play/pause/stop to Trakt as you watch. Optional; default on.
